title: The Iliad: The Embassy Fails
subtitle: The Greeks' best offer meets Achilles's immovable no

offer.excerpt: will make amends, and will give him great gifts by way of atonement. I will tell them in the presence of you all. narrativeBlocks.title: Defeat forces humility
narrativeBlocks.body: With Achilles out, the war turns. Hector drives the Greeks back to their ships, and Agamemnon — desperate — finally admits the quarrel was madness. He sends an embassy to Achilles's tent.

narrativeBlocks.title: The shopping-list of amends
narrativeBlocks.body: The offer is staggering: seven tripods, ten talents of gold, twenty cauldrons, twelve prize horses, seven skilled women, Briseis returned untouched — and his daughter's hand in marriage after the war.

narrativeBlocks.title: Achilles's answer
narrativeBlocks.body: He hates 'even as the gates of hell' the man who says one thing and hides another. He will not fight. Gifts cannot buy back the honour that was stripped — and tomorrow, he says, he may simply sail home.

narrativeBlocks.title: Phoenix's last plea
narrativeBlocks.body: Old Phoenix, who raised Achilles as a child, begs him by their bond. Ajax is blunter: this stubbornness is destroying your friends. Achilles softens just slightly — he will fight only when fire reaches his own ships.

narrativeBlocks.title: The loneliest 'no' in literature
narrativeBlocks.body: The embassy fails because Achilles's grievance has outgrown any compensation. Honour cannot be repaid in tripods — only the coming catastrophe will move him.

quiz.prompt: How does Achilles respond to Agamemnon's enormous offer of gifts?

choices.text: He accepts the gifts but refuses to forgive Agamemnon
He doubles the demand and keeps negotiating
He refuses — no compensation can repair the stripped honour; he will fight only when fire reaches his own ships
He sails home to Phthia that night

quiz.explanation: Achilles rejects the whole offer — the insult is beyond material repair — and sets one condition: he fights when the battle reaches his own ships.

quiz.prompt: What slight concession does Achilles finally make to the embassy?

choices.text: He accepts Briseis back but not the gold
He agrees to fight if Agamemnon asks in person
He lends his armour to any volunteer
He will fight only when the Trojan fire reaches his own ships

quiz.explanation: Phoenix's and Ajax's pleas shift him only to this: he fights when the battle reaches his own ships.
